chars.D: DRIVER: a slim young Moroccan man wearing a black chauffeur suit, crisp white shirt open at the collar, black shoes.
chars.H: HAJJA: a plump elegant Moroccan woman about 45 wearing an emerald-green velvet kaftan with gold embroidery, a gold belt and gold bracelets.
chars.J: HAJJ: a stout older Moroccan man with a grey beard drawn on his white head, wearing a cream djellaba and a red fez.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a luxurious villa kitchen, HAJJA leans over the table and piles a huge steaming tagine portion onto DRIVER's plate with a ladle, smiling warmly at him like a doting mother, while DRIVER sits surprised. Seen from the kitchen doorway, head-to-waist framing, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: DRIVER eats happily at the villa dining table full of the best dishes (roast chicken, pastilla, fruit), HAJJA standing behind him pours him a glass of fresh orange juice, looking at him tenderly.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the villa garage, DRIVER stands next to a shiny black luxury sedan holding a thin plain paper salary envelope, looking at it modestly, a little sad.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the villa marble hallway, HAJJA discreetly presses a thick stack of plain banknotes into DRIVER's hand, glancing sideways as if it is a secret, DRIVER wide-eyed and stunned.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In an elegant villa living room with velvet sofas, HAJJA sits alone, sad, holding a framed photo against her chest, a tear on her cheek, soft evening light from the window.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: DRIVER takes a suitcase out of the trunk of the black luxury sedan in front of a Moroccan airport terminal entrance, HAJJ in his djellaba walks toward the doors waving goodbye. Daytime.
